messages:
Alice: Heads-up: PR #4923 touches infra/* and services/model-serving/* — CODEOWNERS only lists @eng-infra for infra/ and @eng-runtime for model-serving. Who can approve this combined change? https://git.redwood.ai/r/redwood/infra/pulls/4923
Ben: cc @Caroline — ownership is split. I tried to split but the test harness move requires infra edits in the same PR.
Caroline: For the model-serving side I can approve. eng-infra needs to sign off on infra/* changes. If infra owner is not available, we usually do a proxy or an exception.
Dmitri: Heads-up the infra owner is OOO until Fri (rotation). We have a fallback policy: approvals-bot permits team-lead proxy when all listed owners are absent.
Alice: Is that documented anywhere? I don't want to accidentally bypass CODEOWNERS without a record.
Ben: We can either split the PR further or add a one-off CODEOWNERS exception for this glob. Splitting is cleaner but more work.
Caroline: If you go the exception route, add a clear comment like: "temp-codeowners: eng-platform-leads until 2023-07-20" so it's auditable. approvals-bot will annotate merges.
Liza: Also add a short rationale in the PR description and tag the lead to acknowledge in-thread. Saves questions later. :thumbsup:
approvals-bot: Policy note: if all CODEOWNERS are absent for >24h, allow proxy approval by @eng-platform-leads. Exception must be recorded in PR description with who merged.
Alice: Okay — I'm going to split the test harness changes into #4924 and keep the rest in #4923 to minimize infra blast radius. Opening now.
Ben: Thanks — if you want, I can proxy approve infra for the smaller PR once split lands. Let's avoid a permanent CODEOWNERS change.
Caroline: Agree. If split doesn't land by EOD, we can do the temp CODEOWNERS change with expiry.
Alice: Done — opened #4923 (service rename + small edits) and #4924 (infra/test harness). Added PR notes: "temp-approval-plan if owners unavailable".
Ben: Perfect. I'll follow up in #4924 once tests are green and proxy if needed.
Caroline: Leaving a resolving ack here: will approve model-serving in #4923 after CI.
Dmitri: Noted — will add calendar OOO note so approvals-bot knows owner absent window.
Liza: Thanks all — good plan.
Alice: Closing loop: splitting reduced risk and avoided touching CODEOWNERS. Marking this thread resolved.
